title: Book One · Chapter 178: Five Minutes
story:
It is nearly four when Dad comes.

Ronan is by the far table. He moves a little paper boat under the bridge. A girl watches him.

Leo sees Dad first.

He touches Ronan’s arm and points.

Dad stands in the doorway with his work bag. There is a pale mark on one sleeve. His hair is flat on one side.

Ronan leaves the table, then looks back.

“Mei?”

She nods and steps into his place.

Ronan walks quickly to the door.

“You came.”

“I have a few minutes.”

Dad puts his bag against the wall.

“What do you want me to see first?”

Ronan looks around the room.

There are so many things to show Dad. Ronan wants to tell him about each one. He also wants to explain the move away from the window.

But Dad has only a few minutes. Ronan must choose one thing first.

“The stool.”

The stool is empty now. Mr Qiu patted the seat, then went to open his table. “Mr Qiu sat here,” Ronan tells Dad.

Dad looks at the card.

“You wrote repaired.”

“Because you repaired it.”

Dad runs one hand over the seat.

“Yes.”

“People used it today. Mr Qiu sat on it for a long time.”

“Does it hold?”

“It holds.”

Dad sits down for a moment. Ronan stands beside him.

From there, Dad can see the whole map. He finds the green gate without help.

“That is us.”

“And this is the school road.”

Ronan follows the line with his finger. He keeps it above the paper.

Dad leans forward.

“Where is your mum’s work?”

Ronan takes him to the cloth bag. Mum stands beside it, talking to another woman. She looks up and sees Dad.

“You made it.”

“For a little while.”

He looks at the bag, then at the small card.

“Nice straight lines.”

“I did one side twice,” Mum says.

“I know that part of a job.”

They smile at each other.

Ronan pulls Dad gently toward the drawings. He shows him Mei’s work. Then he points to Leo’s parts of the display.

He begins to say, “I made—”

Then he stops.

“We made this part together.”

Dad looks closely. He asks two questions. Ronan answers one and calls Leo for the other.

The room is getting quieter. People pick up bags and say goodbye. Miss Wu starts to clear her desk.

Dad takes his work bag from the wall.

“I must go back.”

Ronan wants to ask for more time.

He looks at Dad's marked sleeve. Dad looks tired. He still has some work to finish.

“Did Mr Sun let you come?”

“Yes. I still have work to finish.”

“You can tell him I said thank you.”

“I will.”

At the door, Dad turns back.

“You found a good place for the stool.”

Ronan looks at it.

“It is useful here.”

“It is.”

Dad leaves. Ronan watches him walk down the hall.

He has not seen every picture. He has not heard every story. Ronan still wants more time with Dad.

But he has seen the stool. He has seen Mum’s name and the road to their home.

Mei calls from the table.

“Can you hold this end?”

Ronan turns around.

“Yes. I’m coming.”
studyGuide:
## 重点表达
- pale：浅色的。
- a few：几个、少量。
- useful：有用的。
- tired：疲倦的。

## 理解
1. Dad时间有限，Ronan怎样选择展示内容？
2. Dad来了以后，哪些愿望得到回应，哪些仍有遗憾？
